items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: I believe that's on the corner of Blunt on his side... He used to play like that.

ctx.x: He wouldn't get loud though, huh?

No, I believe that's on the corner of Blunt on his side. I don't know, maybe he lets the devil play real loud. He used to play like that. Oh, they used to go for him. He used to put on some stuff, probably know he was killing. He the first one to do the show horn.
